en.title: 3D: moving cloth stays visible, distance culling, a clearer sky, and which entry has what
en.body: From the notes of Tea Horse Road, a 3D off-road game. Cloth, ropes and trails whose points move in place now have bounds where their points are: a tarp on a truck that had driven off used to be culled where it was made (`Geometry3D.boundsVersion`, counted by `invalidateBounds`). Meshes take `cullDistance`, beyond which they are neither drawn nor cast a shadow, for grass and props; the docs show `Lod3D` with instanced meshes for near and far versions. `createAtmosphere3D` takes `skyFog`, so the fog can leave the sky clear. `createGradientCubeTexture3D` reads colours given as fractions (0 to 1) as well as bytes: given fractions, a sky used to be nearly black, which was the black skybox reported under software rendering. The world3d page lists which functions are only in the backend entries, and says what a cloth's `right` and `down`, a rope's `slack`, a one-way pin, a wheel's `node`, a stream tile's centre and `createDecal3D`'s material change mean.

zh.title: 3D：移动的布料不再消失、按距离剔除、更清楚的天空、各入口有什么
zh.body: 来自 3D 越野游戏《茶马古道》的笔记。布料、绳子和拖尾的点原地移动后，包围球会跟着更新：过去车开出去后，篷布会在它被创建的位置被剔除（新增 `Geometry3D.boundsVersion`，由 `invalidateBounds` 递增）。网格支持 `cullDistance`，超过这个距离既不绘制也不投影，适合草和小物件；文档补充了用 `Lod3D` 配合实例网格做远近两套模型。`createAtmosphere3D` 支持 `skyFog`，雾可以不盖住天空。`createGradientCubeTexture3D` 除字节外也接受小数（0 到 1）颜色：过去传小数会得到几乎全黑的天空，这正是软件渲染下"天空盒是黑的"的原因。world3d 文档列出了只在后端入口里的函数，并写明布料的 `right` / `down`、绳子的 `slack`、单向钉住、车轮的 `node`、地形块中心和 `createDecal3D` 改写材质的含义。
